items.headline: OneCore Global patents e-confirmation format tech
items.summary: OneCore Global received a US patent for a dynamic-format electronic confirmation system covering trade confirmations, invoices and settlement documents, aimed at cutting manual processing and improving audit trails in commodity post-trade workflows.

items.headline: Santander digitalizes Brazil trade finance via Komgo
items.summary: Banco Santander became the first Brazilian bank to digitalize trade finance processes using Geneva fintech Komgo's Konsole platform, supporting Brazil's push toward a record trade surplus this year.

items.headline: Houthi attacks revive Red Sea shipping risk
items.summary: Renewed Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure have raised the risk of fresh Red Sea shipping disruption just as carriers head into 2027 contract negotiations, adding uncertainty for freight-dependent commodity flows.

items.headline: EMIR REFIT shifts focus to reporting quality
items.summary: Post go-live, EU EMIR REFIT scrutiny is moving from mere technical submission to proving derivatives reports are accurate and properly controlled, with firms urged to clarify internal ownership of reporting duties.
